partition.description: Infrastructure cost to open/establish a partition at a location. Supports all ASIL levels (0-4). max_per_asil_per_site bounds the partitions of one ASIL at one site (3 = the slot count of the v1 model).

site.description: Caps and fixed activation cost of the control unit at a site. null = unlimited, fixed_cost 0 = free: this reproduces the v1 model. Capacity caps are totals over all partitions of the site (same units as partition capacities).
